info.name: E-Learning API
info.description:
# 🎓 E-Learning Platform RESTful API

A role-based E-Learning RESTful API built with **Laravel 11**, **PHP 8.2+**, and **MySQL**.  
Provides structured workflows for **Admins**, **Instructors**, and **Students**, featuring course moderation, ownership authorization, duplicate enrollment protection, queued notifications, and media uploads.

---

### 🧰 Tech Stack & Architecture

- **Core & Framework:** PHP 8.2+ | Laravel 11
    
- **Database & ORM:** MySQL 8 | Eloquent ORM (Relationships & Eager Loading)
    
- **Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum (Stateful & Bearer Token Authentication)
    
- **Authorization & Security:** Custom Middleware, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Ownership Policies
    
- **Background Processing:** Laravel Events, Queued Listeners, and Queue Workers
    
- **Notifications:** Laravel Notification System (Asynchronous updates for course reviews & new lessons)
    
- **Data Transformation & Validation:** Laravel API Resources (Consistent JSON responses) & Form Requests
    
- **File Management:** Laravel Storage (Handling profile avatars, lesson media, and video uploads)
    

---

### ⚙️ Environment Variables Setup

Configure the following variables in your Postman Environment:

| Variable | Description | Initial Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base_url` | Root API URL | `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api` |
| `auth_token` | Sanctum Bearer token | `Bearer token from login/register` |
| `course_id` | Active Course ID for testing nested routes | `1` |
| `lesson_id` | Active Lesson ID for media endpoints | `1` |

---

### 🔐 Authentication & Global Headers

All protected routes require a valid **Sanctum Bearer Token**.

- **Type:** Bearer Token (`Bearer {{auth_token}}`)
    
- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Accept`: `application/json`
        
    - `Content-Type`: `application/json` _(use_ `_multipart/form-data_` _for file uploads)_
        

---

### 👥 Platform Roles & Workflows

- **Admin:** Manages platform users and reviews/approves instructor course submissions.
    
- **Instructor:** Creates courses (set to `pending` by default), manages own lessons, and views enrolled students.
    
- **Student:** Browses approved courses, self-enrolls, and accesses learning content for enrolled courses.
